resources.string: First select your SoundTouch model. Then we will show you how to get started.
The speaker opens its own Bose Wi-Fi network. You do not need to enter its name.
Cannot set up this model? Send feedback
Android will open a Wi-Fi selection window. Select the Bose setup network.
Once connected, the setup continues automatically.
Unable to connect? Send model feedback
Select the Wi-Fi network you want your SoundTouch to use. The list shows networks detected by the speaker.
Select Wi-Fi or enter a name
Enter the password for the selected Wi-Fi network.
Sending Wi-Fi settings to your SoundTouch.
No browser available to open the STR website.
Help us test more SoundTouch models.
Search for a model or enter your own
Wi-Fi setup has been tested successfully with this model.
No email app found. Please set up an email client.
The Wi-Fi connection needs the requested Android permission.
Wi-Fi scan unavailable. Enter the network name manually.
Android is reconnecting to your Wi-Fi…
SoundTouch found, but connected to a different Wi-Fi network.
Setup has not been confirmed automatically.
1. Tap Connect to SoundTouch.\n2. Select the Bose Wi-Fi network in the Android dialog.\n3. Approve the connection even though it has no Internet.
If the speaker is not shown, check that its Wi-Fi light is amber, then tap Try again.
Select the network you want your SoundTouch to use. These networks were detected by the speaker.
Your SoundTouch needs compatible WPA2 Wi-Fi. Bose transfers the password over unencrypted HTTP on the temporary setup network. Only use this in a trusted environment.
Android will restore your regular Wi-Fi. We will check your SoundTouch and show the result.
SoundTouch Reborn (STR) must be installed on the speaker before you can control it with Remote for STR. Until then, it stays grey in the device list.
Optional: Open a draft email to str-remote-android@gmx.org with your model, result, app and Android versions. Review before sending. No Wi-Fi data.
Wi-Fi credentials may already have been sent. Check your speaker before trying again.
1. Turn on the speaker.\n2. Hold preset 2 and Volume Down (−) together for about five seconds.\n3. Wait for the Wi-Fi light to turn solid amber.
Untested model: These steps may not work. If you do not see an amber Wi-Fi light or a Bose setup network, do not send Wi-Fi settings. You can report an unsuccessful attempt.
Wi-Fi setup requires Android 10 or later.
Enter a network name with 1–32 basic characters.
Enter a model name (2–60 characters) and select Yes or No.
No compatible WPA2 networks found. You can enter the name manually.
Your SoundTouch is searching for available Wi-Fi networks…
Network request rejected: invalid Android configuration.
SoundTouch connected. Select the Wi-Fi it should use.
Connected to SoundTouch. Checking the speaker…
Connected! Checking the SoundTouch before selecting Wi-Fi…
Please wait while the SoundTouch switches Wi-Fi networks.
Connected to Wi-Fi. Searching for your SoundTouch…
The app cannot request a Wi-Fi network. Check the installed app version.
Android is searching for the SoundTouch. Select the Bose Wi-Fi in the system dialog and approve the connection.
The Wi-Fi selection was cancelled or the connection failed. Check for an amber Wi-Fi light and tap Try again.
The SoundTouch may be switching to the new Wi-Fi network. Wait for the result.
Connection to SoundTouch lost. Check setup mode and try again.
Android denied the Wi-Fi request (SecurityException). Check Wi-Fi and app permissions.
Could not prepare the SoundTouch for Wi-Fi setup. Connect again.
No Wi-Fi list available. Scan again or enter the network name manually.
Check the Wi-Fi name and password. The WPA2 password must contain 8–63 characters.
SoundTouch acknowledged the Wi-Fi settings. Checking whether it has connected.
The transfer could not be confirmed. We will still look for the SoundTouch on your Wi-Fi.
Automatic verification is not available for this speaker. Neither the transfer nor the Wi-Fi connection could be independently confirmed.
Waiting for your phone to reconnect to Wi-Fi, then searching for your SoundTouch…
Done! Your SoundTouch was found on the phone Wi-Fi and identified by its device ID.
Your SoundTouch was not found on the phone Wi-Fi. It may still be connecting or may be on a different network. You can search again without resending the password.
The background connection to SoundTouch was closed. Please reconnect.
Android is releasing the previous Wi-Fi selection. A new connection dialog will appear.
Searching for Bose Wi-Fi. Confirm the Android selection…
Done! Your SoundTouch was found on your Wi-Fi. Its active network is %1$s.
Your SoundTouch was found, but Bose reports it is connected to %1$s. Check that you selected the intended network.
Bose setup Wi-Fi disconnected during transfer.
The SoundTouch 20 III shows a countdown followed by Setup on its display.
The SoundTouch 10 has no text display. Look for a solid amber Wi-Fi light.
Preset 2 + Volume Down is unverified for this model. Continue only if a Bose setup Wi-Fi network appears.
